purpose: Single source of truth for what this ~/.claude install is supposed to contain. scripts/check-manifest.ps1 validates the live filesystem against this file at SessionStart and reports drift.

policy.claudeMdMaxBytesReason: CLAUDE.md is loaded into every turn. It reached 17848 bytes by accretion before the 2026-07-29 reorganization, which cut it to 8555 across 27 rules with no rule dropped - the detail moved into skills. 9000 is that measured floor plus a little headroom. It was briefly set to 7000, which could only have been met by deleting rules that must be true before a skill loads, so the number was raised deliberately and recorded here rather than adjusted silently later. The gate exists to catch drift back toward 17848, not to force deletion.
policy.onMissingRequired: Tell the user, in Korean, which required assets are missing and that they should be restored from the repo. Do not silently continue as if the rule set were complete.
policy.onOrphan: A skill on disk but absent from this manifest is unregistered. Either add it here or delete it. Report it; do not ignore it.

files.role: Always-loaded global rules. Budget-checked against policy.claudeMdMaxBytes.
Human-facing Korean guide to the whole setup. Not loaded by the model.
The validator this manifest drives. SessionStart hook.

Mechanical enforcement of the four rules with a zero-false-positive signature: work-rules-shell SH-2 NUL bytes, SH-15 .bat with LF, SH-12 UnicodeEncodeError, SH-23 README after a structural commit. Registered on PostToolUse (Write|Edit asyncRewake, Bash filtered to git) and PostToolUseFailure. No PreToolUse: see work-rules-automation AU-21.

PreToolUse scanner for command text naming a construct known to be wrong: work-rules-shell SH-4, SH-5, SH-8, SH-9, SH-10, SH-1. Bash built-ins only, no forks - measured 190 ms per call against 550 ms with one grep per pattern and 600-700 ms in PowerShell.

Reminds the model to consider a verify-fanout brief before editing a file this session has not written (CLAUDE.md G-10). A suggestion, not a gate - it does not deny and it does not run an agent, because a script hook cannot spawn one (work-rules-automation AU-26). A per-session ledger keeps it from firing on files just authored.
Korean document length measurement, used by work-rules-writing WR-12.
Global memory index for the home directory scope. Machine-specific path key; absent on a fresh machine is normal.

settingsKeys.role: Background file checks; wakes the model only on a finding, so a clean write costs nothing.
Catches the cp949 UnicodeEncodeError signature in a failed command.
Command-text patterns. Pre, not post, because command text does not change between hook and execution and these constructs are destructive (work-rules-automation AU-21).
Suggests a brief on a file new to this session. Paired with a PostToolUse brief-nudge.sh record that maintains the ledger.

README check on the commit that landed. Deliberately post, not pre: a pre hook reads the index before git add runs (work-rules-automation AU-21). The if filter is prefix matching, which is why work-rules-shell SH-26 requires git -C over cd && git.

newMachine: git clone <repo> into ~/.claude (or clone elsewhere and copy CLAUDE.md, manifest.json, GUIDE.ko.md, skills/, scripts/ in).
Register the SessionStart hook in ~/.claude/settings.json so check-manifest.ps1 runs (see settingsKeys).
Start a session. The validator reports every missing or unregistered asset.
Set the externalApps env overrides, or move the apps to the declared paths, if those skills are needed.
projects/*/memory/ path keys encode the absolute project path; they do not transfer to a machine with different folder layout. That is expected.
